text:
Pri K.: follow-up from the PM: we keep seeing the late-night connection surge. need a very short mitigation roadmap in the runbook (what oncall does in first 10m, safe commands, who to page). who can take pieces?

Noah T.: i'll own a concise triage section. 1 page, copy/paste commands, and a 2-step fast mitigation. target PR in 5 business days.

Lin W.: i'll do the monitoring/automation: expose conn_util, add a tiny curl endpoint and a CI smoke. plan to add a PromRule + alert annotation linking to the runbook. due 2024-06-18.

Grace H.: i'll own escalation mapping and pager text. i want explicit thresholds in the doc so alerts and runbook stay aligned. proposal: conn_util > 0.78 for 6m -> L2 pager, >0.93 for 2m -> L1 + exec. will include weekend fallback list. due 2024-06-12.

Noah T.: initial triage snippets i'll add to the runbook:
```
# quick active connections
psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active';"
# check app errors for connection resets
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=api --since=10m | grep -i "connect"
# safe short mitigation: pause job runner (feature-flag)
# emergency: restart worker deployment
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/worker --timeout=60s
```

ops-bot: Created tasks: TASK-3345 (triage one-pager) assigned Noah T. due 2024-06-14, TASK-3346 (monitoring + health) assigned Lin W. due 2024-06-18, TASK-3347 (escalation map) assigned Grace H. due 2024-06-12. Link: https://tracker.redwood/TASK-3345

Pri K.: PM requests owners + deliverables in tracker by EOD tomorrow. confirm or update dates now. also include a 2-line test plan in each PR.

Noah T.: confirmed. TASK-3345 -> 2024-06-14. PR will include a 5-step validation for oncall.

Lin W.: confirmed. TASK-3346 -> 2024-06-18. i'll add a curl example and a small PromQL: `sum(rate(db_conn_usage[5m])) / sum(db_conn_capacity)` and include alert annotation with runbook URL.

Grace H.: confirmed. TASK-3347 -> 2024-06-12. i'll add pager message templates and weekend phone fallback.

Pri K.: we should also capture the recurring root: overlapping nightly jobs. someone to own a separate action for job schedule changes and backoff?

Noah T.: i'll draft a short proposal and assign to app-team leads. will open TASK-3348 for job-staggering design, due 2024-06-21.

Lin W.: suggest adding an automated safety: stop new job submissions if conn_util > 0.85 for 3m. i'll include that as an optional hook in TASK-3346.

Grace H.: once PRs merge, let's run a 20m runbook walkthrough with oncall. i'll schedule and include a checklist so oncall can practice the fast mitigation.

Pri K.: perfect. weekly 15m sync until tasks are closed. tag TASK-3345/3346/3347/3348 in PRs and the postmortem link. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
